title: Communications & Channels
objective: Unify SMS/email/voice/chat/social channels under governed conversational automation.

subgoals.title: Inventory channel adapters and inbox
subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count
subgoals.reuse_instruction: Deep-scan and compare the referenced Library donor code before implementation. Converge/port/adapt verified behavior; do not rebuild an existing system from scratch unless donor incompatibility or absence is proven and recorded.

relevant_file_refs.finding: Connect already has the strongest company-scoped provider registry, connection model and unified inbox across external/internal communications.
Omnichannel contributes broader channel/catalog and field-service inbox behavior to inventory, but should not replace Connect's provider/inbox authority.

Deep scan of 967-file Omni v4.5.0 bundle concluded generic channel runtime is weaker/duplicative versus Connect; selectively port communication preflight/compliance, Slack, WhatsApp templates, telephony provisioning/ConversationRelay, Gmail actions and optional Telegram group intelligence.
V0.1.48 is verified complete over v0.1.44–v0.1.48 with 55/55 payload byte matches and 78/78 tests; use as donor provenance, not active communication authority.

code_discovery.scan_notes: Executable authority should converge around Titan Connect plus selected Omnichannel capabilities. Omni/Nano are donor/provenance only until their recorded master paths are physically restored.

code_discovery.scan_notes: Do not import Omni's generic sender/runtime wholesale. Extend Connect's canonical outbound lifecycle with PREPARED/AWAITING_APPROVAL, governance decision refs, Signal/Rewind receipts and cost/policy fields.
